name: chart
description: Fetch chart-ready historical price, dividend, split, and earnings data for a symbol.

queryOptions.description: Chart options. Must include period1; may include period2, interval, includePrePost, events, and return.

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: historical
description: Get historical price, dividend, or split records for a symbol.

queryOptions.description: Historical options. Must include period1; may include period2, interval, events, and includeAdjustedClose.

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: quoteSummary
description: Get quote summary data modules such as price, summaryDetail, assetProfile, and secFilings.

queryOptions.description: Optional query options passed to yahooFinance.quoteSummary().

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: fundamentalsTimeSeries
description: Get financial statement time series data such as financials, balance sheet, or cash flow data.

queryOptions.description: Fundamentals options. Must include period1 and module; may include period2, type, merge, padTimeSeries, lang, and region.

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: quote
description: Get real-time or near real-time quote data for one or more Yahoo Finance symbols.

query.description: Yahoo Finance symbol or symbols, e.g. "AAPL" or ["AAPL", "MSFT"].

queryOptions.description: Optional quote options such as fields or return: "array", "object", or "map".

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: quoteCombine
description: Get quote data for a single symbol through yahoo-finance2's debounced quote combiner.

queryOptions.description: Optional quote options such as fields. quoteCombine always returns a single quote result.

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: search
description: Search Yahoo Finance instruments, companies, and related news by symbol, name, or keyword.

query.description: Search term, company name, or symbol, e.g. "Apple" or "AAPL".

queryOptions.description: Optional search options such as quotesCount, newsCount, region, lang, or enableFuzzyQuery.

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: options
description: Get options chain data including calls, puts, strikes, expirations, and quote data.

queryOptions.description: Optional query options passed to yahooFinance.options().

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: insights
description: Get Yahoo Finance analyst insights, reports, significant developments, and event data for a symbol.

queryOptions.description: Optional query options passed to yahooFinance.insights().

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: screener
description: Run a predefined Yahoo Finance stock screener such as day_gainers, day_losers, or most_actives.

queryOptions.description: Optional screener options such as scrIds, count, region, lang, or start.

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: recommendationsBySymbol
description: Get related and similar stock recommendations for one or more symbols.

query.description: Yahoo Finance symbol or symbols, e.g. "AAPL" or ["AAPL", "MSFT"].

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.

name: trendingSymbols
description: Get Yahoo Finance trending symbols for a region such as US, GB, or DE.

queryOptions.description: Optional trending symbols options such as lang, region, or count.

moduleOptions.description: Optional yahoo-finance2 module options such as validateResult, validateOptions, queue, or fetchOptions.
